_comment: Model roster and context arms. Roster rule: models released within roughly the last two months at freeze time - a benchmark of current tooling should run current models. Tier names are how charts group models; exact model ids are pinned at freeze time. Meta models route through OpenRouter (no native Meta provider in leviath yet). The mockx entry exists only for offline smoke runs against the deterministic script provider.
_released: Release dates are the date the model became generally available on its API; for the GPT-5.6 family that is the 2026-07-09 general launch, not the 2026-06-26 limited-preview announcement. run_quality.py records each model's age at round start in round.json.
